title: Completed-tensor equation for section-normalized reindexing composition
statement: Fix a prime l and a finite extension E of Q_l in universe u. Let A be a PodReindexFamily l E [def-pod-completion-reindex-coherence]. Write L_W for (podReindexCalculus l E W).reduction, R_W for coefficientSequenceLimit l E W, F_f for podOrdinaryReindex l E f, and P_f for integralComparisonDerivedSequencePullback l E f. Write alpha_f and beta_f for (A.completion f).reduction and .limit, kappa_(h,f) for A.compositionDerived l E h f, and sigma_(h,f) for integralComparisonSystemComposition l E h f [def-trf-integral-comparison-sequence-systems]. Assume PodCompletionReindex.Laws l E f (A.completion f) for every scheme isomorphism between schemes on which l is invertible [def-pod-completion-reindex-models]. Assume A.composition h f acts on every original local section by restriction along the inverse component of MorphismProperty.Over.mapComp h f. Assume also PodCompletedTensorReindex.Laws l E f (A.completion f) (A.tensor f) for each such f [def-pod-completion-tensor-normalization]. Write B_W for integralCompletedTensor l E W, mu_f(M,N) for ((A.tensor f).tensor M N).hom, and F_f^c for A.constructible l E f. Then for every such h:Z→W, f:W→V and M,N in sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E V, kappa_(h,f)(B_V(M,N)) ≫ F_h(mu_f(M,N)) ≫ mu_h(F_f^c M,F_f^c N) = mu_(h≫f)(M,N) ≫ B_Z(kappa_(h,f)(M),kappa_(h,f)(N)). No ambient reduction or total-limit composition equation is part of this conclusion.

proof.text: Choose flat-term K-flat representatives of M,N. All reindexed complexes remain good. At each positive quotient, apply Generators to a homogeneous pure tensor. Successive restrictions of both tensor factors equal restriction along Over.mapComp by the section formula. QuotientGenerators fixes the coefficient action. Pure tensors generate the tensor modules and maps commute with sheafification units, so these are equalities of whole degreewise maps; QuotientTransition makes them equalities of strict tower maps.

Apply every product projection and both Roos coordinates to identify the entire strict chain maps. Localize that identity. Substitute the Model formulas for the three specified tensor comparisons, cancel the invertible representative comparisons and use naturality of localization factors. This proves the tensor equation on represented inputs. Naturality transports the equality through the chosen representative isomorphisms to M,N. All comparisons remain the specified ones; no faithfulness of finite evaluation is invoked.

theorem podReindexingCompositionTensor
    (A : PodReindexFamily l E)
    (hcompletion : ∀ {V W : Scheme.{u}} (f : V ⟶ W) [IsIso f]
      [∀ v : V, Invertible (l : V.residueField v)]
      [∀ w : W, Invertible (l : W.residueField w)],
      PodCompletionReindex.Laws l E f (A.completion f))
    (htensor : ∀ {V W : Scheme.{u}} (f : V ⟶ W) [IsIso f]
      [∀ v : V, Invertible (l : V.residueField v)]
      [∀ w : W, Invertible (l : W.residueField w)],
      PodCompletedTensorReindex.Laws l E f (A.completion f) (A.tensor f))
    (hcomposition : ∀ {V W Z : Scheme.{u}} (h : Z ⟶ W) (f : W ⟶ V)
      [IsIso h] [IsIso f] (M : scalarReductionSource l E V) (U : Z.ProEt)
      (x : M.val.obj (op ((proEtaleIsoPostcompose (h ≫ f)).obj U))),
      ((A.composition h f).hom.app M).val.app (op U) x =
        M.val.map ((MorphismProperty.Over.mapComp (Q := ⊤)
          (inferInstance : WeaklyEtale h) (inferInstance : WeaklyEtale f)).inv.app U).op x) :
    ∀ {V W Z : Scheme.{u}} (h : Z ⟶ W) (f : W ⟶ V) [IsIso h] [IsIso f]
      [∀ v : V, Invertible (l : V.residueField v)]
      [∀ w : W, Invertible (l : W.residueField w)]
      [∀ z : Z, Invertible (l : Z.residueField z)],
      ∀ M N : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E V,
        (A.compositionDerived l E h f).hom.app
            ((integralCompletedTensor l E V).obj (M.obj,N.obj)) ≫
          (podOrdinaryReindex l E h).map ((A.tensor f).tensor M N).hom ≫
          ((A.tensor h).tensor ((A.constructible l E f).obj M)
            ((A.constructible l E f).obj N)).hom =
        ((A.tensor (h ≫ f)).tensor M N).hom ≫ (integralCompletedTensor l E Z).map
          (Prod.mkHom ((A.compositionDerived l E h f).hom.app M.obj)
            ((A.compositionDerived l E h f).hom.app N.obj))
